content: PyTorch latest stable ~2.11 (2.12 docs live). MPS backend ships in standard wheels since 1.12; needs macOS 12.3+, Apple Silicon, native arm64 Python. Supports fp16 and bf16 (bf16 needs macOS 14+). CAVEAT: GitHub issues #167679 and #177819 report MPS built-but-unavailable on macOS 26 (Tahoe) with PyTorch 2.9-2.10 — verify torch.backends.mps.is_available() on the target macOS before committing a version.
